The operator opened the bare hosted URL and got " "a JSON payload, which is exactly what made a deployed app look broken\n" % ct) raise SystemExit(1) if "id=\"root\"" not in resp.text: sys.stderr.write("ac2 RED: GET / served HTML but not the built SPA document\n") raise SystemExit(1) mounts = [r for r in app.routes if isinstance(r, Mount)] if [getattr(r, "path", "") for r in mounts] != [SPA_MOUNT_PATH]: sys.stderr.write("ac2 RED: the asset mount is not the single mount at %s - the root fix may not re-wire it\n" % SPA_MOUNT_PATH) raise SystemExit(1) asset = client.get(SPA_MOUNT_PATH + "/index-b1t100hermetic0000000000.js") if asset.status_code != 200 or "text/javascript" not in asset.headers.get("content-type", ""): sys.stderr.write("ac2 RED: the composite is broken - the document serves at / but the bundle it names answers %d. verification_commands.ac3:
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"
command -v uv >/dev/null || { echo "RED: uv is missing from PATH - the project runner is uv by contract"; exit 1; }

test -f backend/app/main.py || { echo "ac3 RED: backend/app/main.py is missing"; exit 1; }
cd backend || { echo "ac3 RED: backend/ is missing - run this fence from the repository root"; exit 1; }
uv run pytest tests/unit/test_smoke.py -q >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "ac3 RED: tests/unit/test_smoke.py is red - the t1 smoke contract (GET / answers 200 with {\"status\":\"ok\"} on the committed route-free tree) is a keeper, not a casualty"; exit 1; }
uv run pytest tests/unit/test_static_serving.py -q >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "ac3 RED: tests/unit/test_static_serving.py is red - the frozen t24 static suite must survive the root-path change"; exit 1; }
uv run python - <<'PYAC3' || exit 1
import sys
from starlette.routing import Mount
from starlette.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import SPA_FALLBACK_PATH, SPA_INDEX_FILE, create_app, resolve_static_dir

if resolve_static_dir().joinpath(SPA_INDEX_FILE).exists():
    sys.stderr.write("ac3 RED: backend/static carries an index.html on the committed tree. The build output must never "
                     "be committed: it is what makes the committed tree route-free\n")
    raise SystemExit(1)
app = create_app()
paths = [getattr(r, "path", "") for r in app.routes]
if [r for r in app.routes if isinstance(r, Mount)]:
    sys.stderr.write("ac3 RED: the committed tree registers a Mount - the static wiring must stay gated\n")
    raise SystemExit(1)
if SPA_FALLBACK_PATH in paths or "/*" in paths:
    sys.stderr.write("ac3 RED: an unconditional catch-all is registered on the committed tree\n")
    raise SystemExit(1)
if paths.count("/") != 1:
    sys.stderr.write("ac3 RED: the committed tree registers %d routes at \"/\", expected exactly 1. The frozen t24 "
                     "assertion paths.count(\"/\")==1 is a keeper: the root must stay ONE route that changes what it "
                     "returns, not grow a second competing route or a second registration\n" % paths.count("/"))
    raise SystemExit(1)
client = TestClient(app)
root = client.get("/")
if root.status_code != 200:
    sys.stderr.write("ac3 RED: GET / answered %d on the route-free tree\n" % root.status_code)
    raise SystemExit(1)
if root.json() != {"status": "ok"}:
    sys.stderr.write("ac3 RED: GET / on the route-free tree answered %r, expected {\"status\": \"ok\"} - the JSON status "
                     "payload stays reachable, which is the recorded half of this card's decision\n" % root.json())
    raise SystemExit(1)
if client.get("/api/v1/health").status_code != 200:
    sys.stderr.write("ac3 RED: /api/v1/health stopped answering - it is the operational probe this card points readers at\n")
    raise SystemExit(1)
if client.get("/openapi.json").status_code != 200:
    sys.stderr.write("ac3 RED: /openapi.json stopped answering\n")
    raise SystemExit(1)
if client.get("/some/client/route").status_code != 404:
    sys.stderr.write("ac3 RED: an unknown path no longer answers 404 on the committed tree\n")
    raise SystemExit(1)
print("ac3 evidence: route-free tree - exactly one \"/\" route, no Mount, no catch-all, GET / -> {\"status\":\"ok\"}, /api/v1/health and /openapi.json 200, unknown path 404, and the three frozen t24 node IDs pass")
print("ac3 GREEN: ROUTE-FREE PREMISE HOLDS - the frozen t1 and t24 assertions need no written amendment because the change is scoped to the static-present case and stays inside the one existing root route")
PYAC3

The orchestrator sweep runner prints 1-based ordinals; a bare number in either direction is a defect.
evidence.base_pinning_policy: Every purity/stability fence derives its BASE at run time - HEAD^ first, then merge-base(main, HEAD), then merge-base(origin/main, HEAD) - printing each candidate, its rejection reason and the acceptance. No main-tip-at-groom literal appears in any fence: the groom-ingest commit always sits between the groom-time tip and any base a builder may legally hold, which is the t102 lesson (WAL 1221/1222). docs/log/orchestrator_wal.jsonl is deliberately excluded from every ALLOWED set.
evidence.monotone_safety: Fences run forever in every later sweep, so nothing here REDs on a fact that only holds until a sibling merges: sibling surfaces are DISCLOSED rather than byte-frozen, changed file sets are compared against the phase_19 UNION of both cards' surfaces, and the verifier gates are compared as a base-vs-HEAD SET in the same generator shape rather than as an absolute GREEN.

definer_decision.definer_decision: RULING ON THE QUESTION THE OPERATOR ASKED TO BE RULED ON AND RECORDED: in the route-free (committed-tree / local development) case GET / KEEPS returning {"status": "ok"}. Recorded reasoning: (1) backend/tests/unit/test_smoke.py asserts that payload and leg 8 (t1, 0-based) runs the file in every sweep, so the payload is load-bearing on a leg this card does not own; (2) the committed tree has no built frontend to serve, and inventing one would mean committing build output; (3) scoping the change to the static-present case is exactly what lets the FROZEN assertions paths.count("/") == 1 and unknown-path-404 (both leg 130, t24) survive WITHOUT any written amendment, because the fix changes what the ONE existing root route RETURNS, never how many routes exist. No frozen assertion is amended by this card, and that is a design constraint on the fix rather than an accident.
definer_decision.shipped_shape: Keep the @application.get("/") decorator, the -> dict[str, str] annotation and the docstring byte-identical (openapi.yaml carries that docstring as the route description, so the prose is contract and may not be improved), return FileResponse(index_file) when resolve_static_dir() / SPA_INDEX_FILE exists, else the status dict. The annotation is then a lie to mypy-strict and the ONE sanctioned repair is a single # type: ignore[return-value] on that return (the repo already carries type: ignore precedents in backend/scripts/). Rejected alternatives were measured: widening the annotation needs response_model=None, which changes the generated schema for / and regenerates openapi.yaml - byte-pinned by leg 227 (t59 ac4, 0-based) - so it is out.
